lines.text: Oh! Someone answered. Hi. I'm Nibs. I've never ordered on the phone before.
Hello, is this [restaurant]? It is? Okay. Good. I practiced this.
Could I please have the [dish]? Just one. Unless that's too many. It's not too many, right?
I'd like the [dish], please. I wrote it down so I wouldn't forget. I still almost forgot.
Do I... tip the delivery duck? How much do ducks get?

choices.reply: Oh, phew. I can do a thank-you.
